landing.problemTitle: Less time on paperwork, more time with your pupils
landing.problemBody: Every day, teachers rewrite the same information: daily notebook, pupil lists, attendance, marks and administrative documents. They hunt for lesson plans in scattered groups and websites. The platform brings everything together and links the tools to each other, so you never write the same thing twice.

faq.a: For any teacher who wants to organise their work in one place: daily notebook, lesson plans, progressions, pupils and documents, in Arabic, French and English. The content is updated and expanded continuously.

faq.q: How is the daily notebook filled in?
faq.a: You enter your timetable once; for each session we suggest the topic and objectives from the lesson plans for that week of the year. You check, edit if needed, then print.

faq.q: Do I need a particular computer or printer?
faq.a: No. The platform works on phones and computers; printing or saving as PDF is done from the browser.
The tools are locked until you subscribe; all your data is kept and comes back as soon as you subscribe.
2,500 DA for the whole year, after a 7-day free trial with no bank card.
By Edahabia or CIB card through Chargily, or contact us for another method.

faq.q: Who can see my pupils' data?
faq.a: Only you. Nobody else can access it, and it is used for nothing else.

welcome.title: Welcome {name} to مساعد الأستاذ
welcome.body: In one minute, discover your digital desk: enter your data once, and the platform takes care of notebooks, lesson plans and documents every day.

today.title: Today: your dashboard
today.body: Every morning starts here: today's sessions, the current session and the remaining steps to set up your desk.
today.tip: Follow the «Let's set up your desk» cards in order: class, pupils, timetable.

classes.title: My classes: the starting point
classes.body: Create your classes all at once (level, group, subjects), then add each class's pupils.
classes.tip: No need to type names one by one: import the list directly from the digitisation file.

schedule.title: Timetable: just once
schedule.body: Enter your weekly sessions: each day's sessions and the daily notebook follow automatically.
schedule.tip: Have it in a file? Import it from Excel, PDF or even a photo, then check.

session.title: The session: one button in class
session.body: Opens the current session from your timetable: attendance, absences and late arrivals in one gesture.
session.tip: Works offline too: changes are saved on the device and synced later.

logbook.title: The notebook that writes itself
logbook.body: The daily notebook in the official template, filled from your timetable and progression: activity, domain, content, components.
logbook.tip: Check it and print it in one click, or edit a row before printing.

lessons.title: Ready-made lesson plans
lessons.body: Each session's plan by sequence and week, for every subject: topic, materials, objectives and procedure.
lessons.tip: This week's lesson plans are shown for your classes and subjects.

library.title: The teaching library
library.body: Textbooks, guides, progressions, posters and exercises, sorted by level and subject.
library.tip: Tap «My classes» to see only your levels.

documents.title: Your documents in seconds
documents.body: Encouragement certificates, monthly absence record, summonses, labels… filled with your pupils' data.
documents.tip: Every document is ready to print in A4.

support.title: We're here for you
support.body: A question, a suggestion or a problem? Write to the team with this button; the reply arrives here.
support.tip: Turn on notifications to be alerted to the reply on your phone.

install.title: Install the platform as an app
install.body: Open it in one tap from your home screen — faster, without the browser bar, and usable even without Internet.

finish.title: You're all set! 🎉
finish.body: Start by adding your first class, then your pupils and your timetable. After that, the notebook writes itself every day.

install.thanks: Installed ✓ You will find it among your apps.
install.ios1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen
